subject: Where is HF-26012?
body: Hi team, could you tell me where container for HF-26012 is right now? Our warehouse wants to plan the unloading. Thanks, Amy

subject: Sendung HF-26038 im Zoll
body: Guten Tag, unsere Sendung HF-26038 steht seit Tagen im Zoll in Hamburg. Welche Dokumente fehlen noch? Wir brauchen die Ware dringend. Mit freundlichen Grüßen, Jonas Weber

subject: Invoice INV-2026-3139 looks wrong
body: Hello, the commercial invoice we received for HF-26040 shows a total of 8,362.32 USD, but our order was for about 3,900. Can you check and send a corrected invoice? Regards, Amy

subject: New booking Singapore → Rotterdam
body: Hi, we'd like to book one 40ft container from Singapore to Rotterdam, ready to load on 2 December. Goods: bicycle frames, about 9 tonnes. Please send a quote. Pieter

subject: Damaged cartons on HF-26037
body: Hi, we unpacked HF-26037 this morning and 14 cartons of plates arrived broken. Photos attached. How do we file a claim? Maria

subject: Webinar: 5 trends in electronics sourcing
body: Join our free webinar next Thursday on five trends shaping electronics sourcing in 2027. Register now, seats are limited!

subject: Status zending HF26019
body: Goedemiddag, kunt u laten weten wanneer zending HF26019 in Rotterdam aankomt? Alvast bedankt, Pieter

subject: Certificate of origin for HF-26038
body: Dear Harbor Freight, customs in Hamburg asks for the certificate of origin for HF-26038. We attach it here. Please forward it to the broker today. Best, Linh

subject: Booking: Yokohama to Felixstowe, January
body: Hello, please reserve space for two 20ft containers Yokohama to Felixstowe, loading 8 January. Machined parts, 14 tonnes in total. Kind regards, Hiroshi Sato

subject: Re: HF-26016 arrival
body: Hi, HF-26016 has been on the water for a while now. When will it reach Felixstowe, and is the ETA still the same? Amy

subject: Facture pour HF-26031
body: Bonjour, la facture pour l'envoi HF-26031 indique un fret de 1 317,60 USD alors que le devis était de 1 100 USD. Pouvez-vous vérifier ? Cordialement, Pieter van der Berg

subject: Customs hold?
body: Hi, our broker says one of our containers might be held by US customs, but he didn't give us the reference. Can you check which shipment it is? Maria

subject: Wet cartons HF-26036
body: Hello, our consignee reports that 6 cartons on HF-26036 were wet when they opened the container. Was there a problem at the port? Hiroshi

subject: Neue Buchung Cat Lai - Hamburg
body: Hallo, wir möchten einen 40-Fuß-Container von Cat Lai nach Hamburg buchen, Abfahrt Mitte Januar. Möbel, ca. 11 Tonnen. Bitte um ein Angebot. Jonas

subject: Where is HF-26099?
body: Hi, can you give me an update on shipment HF-26099? Our customer is asking. Thanks, Hiroshi

subject: Out of office
body: I am out of the office until 3 December with limited access to email. For urgent matters please contact ops@brightwater.example.com.

subject: Two invoices for one shipment
body: Hello, we received two invoices for HF-26003, INV-2026-3102 and a second one without a number. Which one should we pay? Wei Ling

subject: Torn sacks found at inspection
body: Hello, customs in Hamburg inspected HF-26034 and found two coffee sacks torn open. We want to claim for the damaged goods. Jonas

subject: Is HF-26025 released?
body: Hi again, is HF-26025 released by customs yet, or is it still at the port? We need to send a truck. Maria

subject: Packing list missing for customs
body: Hello, the broker in Los Angeles says the packing list for HF-26033 is missing, so customs cannot clear it. Can you send it again? Thanh
